tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Token-linked phone panes with deliberate platform differences. Tokens and component roles stay recognizable across iOS, Android, and web without forcing identical rendering.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Neutral sans type separates task labels, reading text, and compact values. Layout changes are expressed through a shared system instead of one-off mobile overrides.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Color and space respond to mode and brand while state meaning remains stable.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: A small set of primitives earns value by forming coherent screens, not by maximizing component count.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Cross-platform mobile screen pair sharing roles while respecting native structure. The relationship does not require a media layer.
